note: Scores are READINGS, never records. Each is a model's argument from a Wikipedia plot section alone. No edges are emitted here. No pageview or popularity number is written into this file. Not merged into corpus.json.

scale.note: anchors sit at 10 and 90 and are reference points, not ceilings

dread.measures: How much of the running time is spent expecting harm.

cruelty.measures: How the film treats the people in it — whether harm is deliberate, dwelt on, and shared by the film's own gaze.

irony.measures: The distance between what the film shows and what it means — whether the film stands behind its own images.

ambiguity.measures: How much the film refuses to settle — what is still unknowable when it ends.

fracture.measures: How far the telling departs from a single forward order — displacement, permutation, and whether any order can be recovered at all.

axisConfidenceFormulation: grounded-fraction (axes the text grounded / 5) — measured rho 0.1055 vs pageviews, but EFFECTIVELY CONSTANT on this sample (99.5% of films at 1.0)

cruelty.basis: Sitarski's tripping and punching, Wood force-fed prune juice, the ballroom brawl — all played as knockabout with no lasting injury.

fracture.basis: Many parallel strands cross-cut, but one unbroken clock from six days after Pearl Harbor to the next morning.

fracture.basis: 1974 classroom narration interleaves three generations, and his 'perception starts becoming more confused' as he tells it.

dread.basis: Taiwan ambush, a kidnapping and a trap for Kit punctuate long stretches of taxi driving and attempted reconciliation

ambiguity.basis: Shing's betrayal is confessed aloud, he is shot dead, and the brothers walk out reconciled into police custody

fracture.basis: Single forward line with a three-year prison ellipsis; nothing is reordered

dread.basis: Blackouts, a severed finger in his handkerchief, and self-handcuffing sustain a threat Will keeps escaping between transformations.

cruelty.basis: Charlotte found dead in the park, guards killed, an attempted rape and a ruthless mauling — brisk, not dwelt on.

fracture.basis: Bite to transformation to flight, one continuous forward chain.

cruelty.basis: Fed until his stomach bursts, restrained a year alive, raped with a bladed device, a face cut off, a pregnant wife beheaded

ambiguity.basis: Doe explains his design aloud in the car and the finale executes it exactly; only the box's contents stay unshown

fracture.basis: Named consecutive days, Monday onward, with no displacement

dread.basis: Suspicion tightens all day toward a public beating, but the threat is domestic exposure rather than bodily harm

irony.basis: Rouhi's lie creates dramatic irony inside the story, but the film presents the marriage and the festival without distance

fracture.basis: One continuous day, followed through Rouhi's arrivals and departures

ambiguity.basis: Trial, verdict and shootings are shown plainly; only the children's fate is left open as they wander.

fracture.basis: Braided city and tent strands, both moving forward; no event is displaced or re-ordered.

fracture.basis: Drifts between estate, townhouse and Buenos Aires with vague intervals ('after a few days') but never doubles back.

fracture.basis: Single forward walk home, with documentary footage appended as a closing epilogue

irony.basis: Presented as straight dated case history, ending on an earnest line about her love making him a better person

ambiguity.basis: A closing footnote states all four fates by year and cause, closing every thread the film opened

fracture.basis: Dated forward march from August 1904 through America to the final visit, then an epilogue text

fracture.basis: One summer told straight through, each episode following the last

fracture.basis: Dated chronological march January to April, with one flashback to the March 4 address at the very end.

cruelty.basis: Foxes shocked to death on camera, EO beaten nearly to death by the losing team, and the closing captive-bolt shot

fracture.basis: Strict forward chain of stations with 'sometime later' ellipses; no event is displaced

dread.basis: A corpse, a heart attack and a locked vault all land as farce; nothing in the hotel is expected to harm anyone

cruelty.basis: The film parades an Alzheimer's wife, botched surgical faces and a postdated corpse as gags at their expense

irony.basis: Millennium party staged against Yeltsin's live handover and Y2K greed; every figure is a type held at mocking distance

ambiguity.basis: Each thread lands a punchline — Crush rescued, ambassador locked in — though the vault gag is left dangling

fracture.basis: Braided ensemble strands all run forward across one day to midnight

dread.basis: A death from brain hemorrhage and a fatal assault arrive unheralded; the bulk is rehearsal, driving and talk

cruelty.basis: An abusive mother and a daughter who chose not to pull her from the wreckage — confessed, not staged for the camera

ambiguity.basis: Both withheld guilts are spoken aloud in Hokkaido; only the Korean coda — the dog, the healed scar — goes unexplained

fracture.basis: One two-year jump after the funeral; Oto's taped voice recurs but nothing is reordered

ambiguity.basis: An epilogue settles every thread: Ryan arrested, Casey out again, the bills passed, the non-profit founded.

fracture.basis: Straight forward run from Moore's resignation to the non-profit, with no displacement.

dread.basis: A missing niece and a body in a canyon supply real threat, but it is cut with date requests, gags and a flirt at a stoplight

cruelty.basis: A pastor beds congregants and traffics, Mickie is brutally questioned, a girl is held in a basement — all passed through quickly

irony.basis: A running "I like girls" gag bookends the murders and the film closes on flirtation with the killer's associate

ambiguity.basis: MG is named as Mia's killer, her other victims tallied by Marty, and the case is closed in the ambulance

fracture.basis: One forward investigation, with the villains' scenes cut in parallel rather than displaced

dread.basis: An oath sworn in childhood and a fate declared inescapable govern the whole; nights of ritual killing keep the estate braced for the next.

cruelty.basis: Body parts impaled into a horse shape as display, a heart cut out, torture for its location, beheadings — all staged for the camera.

irony.basis: Seeress, sword from a barrow, Odin's ravens and a valkyrie are all taken at their word by the film.

ambiguity.basis: The prophecy is spelled out and fulfilled, mother's reveal is explicit, and the vision confirms the children are safe.

fracture.basis: Dated linear telling with one 'several years later' jump; visions are inserts, not reorderings.

dread.basis: An innocent woman under sentence and a killer being cornered in an audition, but the investigation proceeds briskly with no menace to Sir John.

cruelty.basis: A wrongful conviction Sir John himself votes for, and Fane's trapeze hanging staged for the camera as a performance.

irony.basis: The trap is a play about the case — theatre used as a device — but the film means its conscience-driven investigation plainly.

ambiguity.basis: Motive supplied and a written confession left behind; Mary is collected from prison.

fracture.basis: Forward from trial to confession; only the recounted backstory of Fane's motive sits outside the sequence.

dread.basis: Neighborhood bullies force truancy and a spanking follows, but the threat is settled once Kozou intervenes

cruelty.basis: The father plays the buffoon on film before his boss and his sons watch; the film then gives him a private confession to his wife

irony.basis: Having learned why their father grovels, the boys announce they want to be a lieutenant general and a general, then urge him to greet the boss

ambiguity.basis: Reconciliation over onigiri and a walk to school close it; only the parents' wish for a better future is left open

fracture.basis: Consecutive days in order — truancy, the screening, the strike, the following morning

dread.basis: Kulaks declare resistance early, but the killing on the path comes out of a dance with no approach

cruelty.basis: Vasyl shot from the dark and a priest cursing the mourners, against a death under an apple tree and rain over fruit

irony.basis: The tractor's arrival, the secular funeral's 'new songs for a new life' and the closing embrace are offered without hedge

ambiguity.basis: Khoma confesses at the cemetery, so the one open question closes; renewal ends it

fracture.basis: Lyric montages (wheat, bread from start to finish, rain) interrupt the story without displacing its order

dread.basis: Rape attempt, then a night walking the city in a daze, then a blackmailer holding the matching glove while the detective watches

cruelty.basis: Crewe takes her dress and attacks her; the film then lets a wrong man be chased to his death through a skylight

irony.basis: The laughing clown she slashed is carried past the couple as they leave unpunished — the film's last image mocks them

ambiguity.basis: The killing is settled as self-defence, but whether the two can live with the substituted corpse is left with the clown

fracture.basis: One dated day forward into its aftermath, no displacement

dread.basis: Continuous pursuit — assassins outside the flat, nationwide manhunt, fake police — but each threat is escaped within the scene

cruelty.basis: Smith dies with a knife in her back and Mr Memory is shot mid-sentence; the film moves on immediately both times

irony.basis: Hannay is mistaken for a speaker and improvises a rousing political speech; the comic handcuff detour sits beside the real plot

ambiguity.basis: Mr Memory compulsively defines the 39 Steps and recites the engine design before dying — the withheld phrase is spoken aloud

fracture.basis: Music hall to Palladium in one forward chase, no displacement

dread.basis: Cesare announces Alan will die by dawn and he does; stabbings in beds at night, an abduction, and the box that may hold only a dummy.

cruelty.basis: Killings by proxy on a sleeping man's order, and a director who takes an asylum inmate and experiments him into a murderer.

ambiguity.basis: The framing hands the director back his authority and a cure, but Franzis's account is never disproved — only reattributed.

fracture.basis: Park frame, long flashback, a diary flashback nested inside it about an 18th-century Caligari, then a return that recolours all of it.

dread.basis: Innkeepers terrified at the name, punctures found on waking, the bedroom door opening by itself at midnight, then plague deaths

cruelty.basis: Predation and a strangled warden, but harm arrives as plague and appetite; Ellen's death is her own chosen sacrifice

irony.basis: The book's rule about a pure-hearted woman is enacted literally and the sacrifice is presented without any distance

ambiguity.basis: Orlok vanishes, Knock is shattered, the castle falls — only Ellen's sleepwalking reaching him across distance goes unexplained

fracture.basis: Forward order throughout, with cross-cutting between the castle and Wisburg during Hutter's absence

dread.basis: Worst threat is Eugen storming off with a rifle, defused by a neighbour; the rest is confession, courtship and a stuck elevator.

cruelty.basis: Infidelity, an unheard pregnancy and a refused job — hurt is real but nobody is punished and Paul ends by letting the lovers go.

irony.basis: Confessions are embellished then retracted mid-scene, and Karin frames her marriage crisis as a comedic episode.

ambiguity.basis: Each story is delivered with its outcome attached — Rakel's resolve, Marta's reconciliation, Karin's reunion in the elevator.

fracture.basis: Frame at the table encloses three separately narrated flashback stories, returning to the present between each.

dread.basis: Wandering under investigation with arrest looming, plague village, prison — harm recurs but in discrete episodes, not sustained

cruelty.basis: Workers shun and brawl over him, the dying woman refuses him, cellmates insult and assault him; the film stays for each humiliation

ambiguity.basis: He refuses the pineapple twice, takes it, and is led away 'distraught' — whether faith survives is left unstated

fracture.basis: Picaresque but strictly sequential: hostel, road, town, plague village, arrest, cell, final road

dread.basis: Arrest, four years' jail, interrogation and a death in custody arrive as events; the long middle is courtship and rice fields

cruelty.basis: Noge dies in custody, Yukie is 'treated badly' in interrogation, neighbours destroy the planted fields overnight

irony.basis: The title's conviction is the film's own — reinstatement, honour and returning to the village are offered straight

ambiguity.basis: Noge is publicly honoured, the father accepts her, and her choice to return is stated as her settled purpose

fracture.basis: Continuous 1933-to-postwar chronology, jumps only forward across years

dread.basis: Milly secretly plies Henrietta with drink, fakes hallucinations with a shrunken head, and attempts an overdose — harm is always pending

cruelty.basis: A housekeeper's sustained campaign to destroy a woman's mind, plus a finger-on-trigger wounding; but ends in Charles's protective lie

irony.basis: Confession, sacrifice and the gentleman's word are played straight; no gap between the melodrama shown and meant

ambiguity.basis: Both murders explained, Milly exposed and expelled, Sam cleared, couple smiling at the dock

fracture.basis: One embedded flashback — Henrietta's account of Gretna Green and the brother's shooting — inside an otherwise forward telling

dread.basis: Pursuit is continuous and the siege scene has Lin hand Lola a revolver for the last round on herself

cruelty.basis: Lamont robbed, killed and scalped; Waco provokes Steve into drawing to take the rifle; Dutch shot their father in the back

irony.basis: The vendetta, the rescue and the final embrace are played straight with no gap between image and intent

ambiguity.basis: Dutch's identity as brother is spoken aloud, the rifle returns, the score settles — everything named

fracture.basis: The rifle relays owner to owner but the telling never leaves one forward line

dread.basis: Repeated capture, patrols and a scheduled execution, but each trap is escaped and the peasants' antics defuse the interval

irony.basis: The greedy peasants are comic, but the clan's rescue, the Fire Festival philosophy and Yuki's speech are played straight

ambiguity.basis: Border crossed, identities revealed, gold recovered, peasants rewarded with a shared ryō

fracture.basis: Single forward journey from enlistment to the Hayakawa castle

dread.basis: Once Ellen's jealousy is named, every person Richard loves becomes a target and the film waits with them — Danny, the pregnancy, Ruth

cruelty.basis: Ellen rows alongside Danny urging him on and watches him sink, throws herself downstairs to kill the pregnancy, poisons herself to frame Ruth

irony.basis: The melodrama plays its confessions and courtroom straight; no distance between image and intent

ambiguity.basis: The trial states the mechanism aloud, Ruth is acquitted, Richard serves his sentence and comes home

fracture.basis: Train meeting to homecoming in one unbroken forward order

cruelty.basis: Nicola, Laura and Patrizia tease him, then he is fired after being made to sign away a phantom company while Ada is dying.

fracture.basis: One compressed forward sequence from the supermarket robbery to the final decision, no displacement of any kind.

cruelty.basis: Mental and physical torture as method, an informant murdered in solitary, and a pardon staged only to spring execution

ambiguity.basis: Sándor is never among the prisoners and never appears; identities are the withheld thing throughout

fracture.basis: Historical preface, then one forward sequence: identification, informing, murder, interrogation, the final trap

ambiguity.basis: The good/evil tension explicitly 'collapses': he rescues Gulabi in time and the ending names its own meaning

fracture.basis: Straight decline-and-turn chronology from licence loss to rescue

dread.basis: One localized crisis — a defective consignment against a deadline — with no ongoing expectation of harm to anyone.

irony.basis: Promotion for 'efficient' handling of a crisis he manufactured; congratulations all around over sabotage.

fracture.basis: Straight forward run from Tutul's arrival through the crisis to the promotion.

dread.basis: A friend dies in hospital and a marriage ends; nobody is ever threatened with harm across the day and night

ambiguity.basis: Lidia says she no longer loves him, he insists he does, and the bunker embrace settles neither; his job offer left open too

fracture.basis: Hospital morning to golf-course dawn, continuous

dread.basis: Opens with the execution done; the menace is the killers' own inquiry, with beatings and a sniper only near the close.

ambiguity.basis: Every question the hitmen ask is answered by the last flashback; the money, the double-cross and all parties are closed off.

dread.basis: Jillian besieged by unseen beings and Barry taken; but the sustained state is compulsion and wonder, not expected harm.

cruelty.basis: The abduction is the one deliberate harm and it is undone — the returned haven't aged; the encounter ends in a smile.

irony.basis: The finale — hand signs answered, Roy walking aboard — is offered without any distancing frame.

ambiguity.basis: Coordinates decoded, Barry returned, contact achieved; only the visitors' purpose is left unstated.

fracture.basis: Parallel strands (Lacombe, Roy, Jillian) run forward and converge at Devils Tower; no displacement in time.

irony.basis: The seducer's index of numbers is torn up in earnest; the film plays his conversion straight

ambiguity.basis: Debt paid, car sold, rent settled, and she invites him to dinner — every thread closed

fracture.basis: Strict day-by-day forward order, New York to Atlantic City and back

cruelty.basis: Leonardo dies by farce and Gugo is tricked into a retirement home, yet the film ends by inviting the mistress-creditor to dinner.

irony.basis: Death, debt and betrayal handled at comic distance, closing on the throwaway quip that gives the film its title.

ambiguity.basis: Every thread lands: villa kept, husband's second family revealed, pregnancy declared, affair ended.

fracture.basis: Day-by-day forward ('the next day', 'one night', 'the following day') with no displacement.

dread.basis: The trip is bureaucratic appeal after appeal; the only bodily peril, her winter labour, is resolved safely

cruelty.basis: A kick to the groin and 200 yuan thrown on the ground; the film otherwise watches persistence, not harm

ambiguity.basis: Every fact is settled (broken rib, fifteen days); only her final anguished look is left uninterpreted

fracture.basis: Strict forward order: beating, local police, district, lawyer, court, birth, one-month party, arrest

dread.basis: A missing friend and unaimed cameras; nothing in the text threatens anyone, and the search is curiosity, not fear.

irony.basis: A sequel's fictional director films 'unseen images' shown to no one, beside real musicians and Oliveira as themselves.

ambiguity.basis: Friedrich's absence is explained and the two agree to resume the film, but the 'unseen image' idea is left unadjudicated.

fracture.basis: Postcard, arrival, search, meeting at the end — a single forward quest; the prior film is background, not displacement.

irony.basis: Sandbags, solidarity and a successful harvest are presented without a shred of distance.

ambiguity.basis: Levee repaired, harvest successful; only Wade's parting threat is left unsettled.

fracture.basis: One continuous season-long chronology, farm to mill to flood.

ambiguity.basis: The headlights are never identified and the documents are simply absent from the wreck; whether she was killed is never settled.

fracture.basis: Dated forward chronology from 1972 to the November 13, 1974 crash.

dread.basis: Beatings from childhood on, then war, treason charges, Red Guards — harm is expected across every era the film passes through.

cruelty.basis: Child beaten in another's place, eunuch's rape of Douzi, struggle session paraded through town, mutual denunciation, two suicides.

irony.basis: Opera and life are made to rhyme in earnest — the misspoken 'boy, not girl' line returns as the suicide, not as a joke.

ambiguity.basis: Every thread closes: Juxian's suicide, Xiao Si caught, the 1977 reunion, Dieyi's death completing the play.

fracture.basis: Strict chronology 1924→1977; the jumps are ellipses within one forward order.

dread.basis: Children abducted and an execution ordered, but Hook grants a three-day training reprieve and the mood turns to games.

cruelty.basis: Hook grooms Jack against his father and fatally wounds Rufio; the harm is deliberate but framed as a villain's defeat.

irony.basis: Ends on an unironised line — 'To live will be an awfully big adventure' — and a phone discarded in earnest.

ambiguity.basis: Hook eaten, children home, memory restored, family reunited, Tootles flies off; nothing withheld.

fracture.basis: Linear rescue plot with one recalled block: infancy, Wendy, Moira, Jack's birth, delivered as remembered past.

dread.basis: A helicopter guns the Commission, Mosca stalks in a priest's disguise, and the opera plays under a waiting assassin.

cruelty.basis: Fredo's murder is confessed, Mary is shot dead in her father's arms, and Connie watches Altobello die from the box.

irony.basis: Absolution precedes the poisoned pope and cannoli, and the killings run against Anthony's aria — but grief is sincere.

ambiguity.basis: The swindle, the traitor and each murder are named outright; the coda shows Michael's death plainly.

fracture.basis: One forward line from 1979 through Palermo, closing with a stated seventeen-year jump.

dread.basis: The legend can fail at any moment — a coworker recognises her, the Stasi relocates her, the state protecting her collapses

cruelty.basis: She shoots a policeman, Tatjana is jailed for years merely for knowing her, Hull presses an abortion, Vopos riddle her

irony.basis: Her death is staged as the Paris flight inverted, and the closing voiceover disowns the whole account: 'More or less.'

ambiguity.basis: Her fate is definite, but the framing letter and that final line put the reliability of everything shown in doubt

fracture.basis: Retrospective letter frame around an otherwise chronological run from the 1970s to 1989

dread.basis: An opening montage of war and carnage sets the ground, but Purgatory is lectures and interviews with nothing pending

cruelty.basis: Appropriated documentary footage of war held up as 'Hell', and a woman with books in her bag shot by police

irony.basis: The director plays himself lecturing against shot/reverse shot inside his own film, and Heaven is guarded by marines

ambiguity.basis: Olga's death arrives only as a phone call from someone who 'is sure it was Olga'; the three realms are never reconciled

fracture.basis: Three Dante-named realms, the first non-narrative montage and the last a postlude, with no continuous order across them

dread.basis: Hardship accumulates — forced abortion, unregulated coal mine, permit trouble — but nothing threatens the troupe scene to scene.

cruelty.basis: Zhang forcing Zhong's abortion; Sanming's five yuan and 'tell her never to return' from a mine that will likely kill him.

irony.basis: State-approved numbers give way to a fake Shenzhen rock troupe performing on highway shoulders, noted without comment.

ambiguity.basis: Cui and Yin end married with a son, but years of the troupe's dissolution pass in ellipsis and the train is only ever heard.

fracture.basis: One forward march from 1979 through the tours to the return, with long unmarked gaps between.

dread.basis: Bedridden mother, four-hour trek to market and a neighbour overharvesting make the collapse foreseeable well before it lands.

cruelty.basis: Sam's greed destroys her colony, but it is pressure and disregard rather than malice, and the film keeps playing with his children.

irony.basis: The half-for-the-bees rule is stated and then violated exactly as stated; nothing is framed against itself.

ambiguity.basis: Cause and consequence are explicit — sold all the honey, colonies raided, hive dead, mother dead, family gone.

fracture.basis: Observational forward chronology from arrival of the ranchers to their departure.

dread.basis: After the bathroom blood, Rana won't be alone or bathe, and Emad's private hunt builds to a man locked in a room with heart trouble.

cruelty.basis: Emad engineers the old man's exposure before his family, slaps him in private, and he collapses; Rana's breakdown is watched too.

irony.basis: They perform Death of a Salesman throughout, and Emad's real rage leaks into the play as an off-script insult to Babak's Charley.

ambiguity.basis: Rana can't recall the face, the old man denies assault and claims he only startled her, and he collapses with his fate unstated.

fracture.basis: Continuous forward order from the collapsing building through the assault to the return to the theatre.

dread.basis: A serial killer, a staking machine and dream pursuits, but the register is eccentric — a clock with seven times

cruelty.basis: A priest drugs and murders all the children, chases V down, and her body is found impaled with a stake

irony.basis: The reveal that everything since the first dream was the manuscript, plus post-film text on the series' sales

ambiguity.basis: Dream, manuscript and waking world never separate; Bobby's murder unsolved and Flamingo never seen again

fracture.basis: Nested dream levels that leak into waking, then a frame reveal retroactively reclassifying most of the film

dread.basis: Near-execution, brutal winter deaths, an attack on Jamestown — but long stretches of courtship and wonder carry no threat

cruelty.basis: Pocahontas abducted as a bargaining chip and told a lie that Smith died; yet exile and betrayal are met with reconciliation

irony.basis: Voice-over letter to a son, 'not a dream but the only truth', closing images of nature — no gap between image and intent

ambiguity.basis: Deaths and marriages settle, but the final garden images and 'Mother, now I know where you live' sit outside the literal account

fracture.basis: Straight 1607-onward chronology; only the closing playing-in-the-garden images float free of the death that precedes them

dread.basis: Man-eating giants repeatedly hunt her — the lost blanket exposes her — but every raid is driven off with a snozzcumber or iron.

cruelty.basis: Giants bully the BFG and ate his previous human companion; they are exiled to an island with seeds rather than killed.

irony.basis: The nightmare plan, the Queen's breakfast and the frobscottle are played entirely for what they are.

ambiguity.basis: Giants captured, Sophie adopted, the BFG hears her and smiles — only 'awakens from a dream' lightly unsteadies it.

fracture.basis: One night-to-resolution sequence, straight through.

dread.basis: Debt collectors recur at a school play, a nightclub, outside the auction; Howard is stripped and locked in a trunk before the final gun

cruelty.basis: Beatings by Arno's goons, humiliation in the trunk, and two point-blank killings the film stays in the room for

irony.basis: The parlay wins $1.2 million and he is shot dead moments after being freed — payoff and punishment arrive together

ambiguity.basis: Bet resolved, debt resolved, both deaths shown, Julia leaves with the money

fracture.basis: A 2010 Ethiopian mine prologue displaced ahead of the 2012 main line; nothing else moves

dread.basis: Investigation and stakeout hold suspicion rather than threat; the second corpse and the rising tide arrive late, not as sustained menace.

cruelty.basis: Two engineered deaths and a fentanyl mercy-killing, but the harm is off-screen deduction; the film's attention is on the pair's tenderness.

irony.basis: The declaration of love, the ash-scattering and the burial in sand are played without any wink; the recording is a plot device, not distance.

ambiguity.basis: He never finds her body and never recalls saying he loved her; whether she ever loved or only used him stays unsettled at the close.

fracture.basis: Straight investigation, one titled thirteen-month jump; the murder is re-explained but the telling never leaves forward order.

dread.basis: The death is over before the film begins; the pressure is a verdict awaited, not harm anticipated — bar Daniel's dog test

cruelty.basis: The recorded fight and self-harm are replayed in court, and a blind child is put on the stand to settle it

irony.basis: The novel-mirrors-murder argument is a prosecution move the film takes seriously, not a wink at its own fiction

ambiguity.basis: Acquittal settles the verdict, never the fall; Marge's 'decide what's true for you' installs the withholding as the point

fracture.basis: One-year jump to trial, with the fatal day reconstructed through recording and conflicting testimony

dread.basis: A captive in a basement on a four-day countdown to an eclipse, with a torturer escalating from electricity to a dislocated kneecap

cruelty.basis: Head shaved, electrocuted, kneecap dislocated; a deputy bludgeoned with a shovel, jars of severed body parts, then all humans killed

irony.basis: The lunatic's conspiracy turns out literally true and the abductee is the emperor — the film's premise inverts on itself

ambiguity.basis: The closet really is a teleporter and Michiko's identity is confirmed on the mothership; the ending states what happened

fracture.basis: Single forward order from abduction to extinction; the Atlantis backstory is spoken, not staged out of sequence

dread.basis: Only the pressure of a secret and of rain-emptied houses; the confrontations arrive without being awaited

cruelty.basis: Otaka buys a seduction of the son as revenge; Kihachi slaps Otoki, beats Otaka, then hits Otoki repeatedly

irony.basis: The paternity scene and the final wistful look at a sleeping boy are played entirely straight

ambiguity.basis: Paternity disclosed, the scheme confessed, the troupe disbanded, a new one begun — everything named before the end

fracture.basis: Arrival by train to departure by train in one unbroken forward order

dread.basis: A pistol produced at the wedding, blackmail on the train, sale to a brothel — pressure mounts but long stretches are intrigue

cruelty.basis: Schön orders his wife to shoot herself; Geschwitz is used to lure Quast to his killing; Lulu is knifed while Schigolch eats his pudding

irony.basis: The Christmas-pudding wish granted in the same breath as her murder, and Alwa trailing a Salvation Army parade

ambiguity.basis: Each death, betrayal and sale is stated plainly; only Schigolch and Alwa's ignorance of her fate is withheld from them, not us

fracture.basis: Continuous forward chain from apartment to revue to ship to London garret

dread.basis: Arrests, breakdown and hunger arrive as recurring pratfalls he actively seeks out — he wants jail; no scene waits for harm.

cruelty.basis: The assembly line and the police grind him down, but even the burglars are treated as hungry men and shared drinks with.

irony.basis: He is jailed as a red he never led, decorated for a cocaine accident, and sings his showpiece in deliberate gibberish.

ambiguity.basis: Every episode resolves plainly; only the closing road is left open, and it is named as hopeful.

fracture.basis: Strict episodic chronology — jail, shipyard, store, strike, café — with no displacement.

dread.basis: Machine explosion, the Moloch vision, and the flood rising toward the workers' children keep catastrophe imminent

cruelty.basis: Workers consumed by the machine, children left to drown, a woman burned at the stake before a crowd

irony.basis: Ends on the literal joining of hands between master and foreman, offered without defence

ambiguity.basis: Rotwang dies, the robot is exposed, the mediator thesis is fulfilled onscreen

fracture.basis: Forward order throughout; hallucinations are intercut but never displace the sequence

dread.basis: The father's abuse escalates to cutting off his son's air supply mid-dive; his oncoming blindness is a clock running under it all.

cruelty.basis: Blom calls his son a humpback, humiliates him before the crew, and attempts to murder him at work; the film then paralyses him for years.

irony.basis: Sally's cynicism is voiced by the character, not by the film; the reunion is staged as earned reconciliation.

ambiguity.basis: The argument ends with her agreeing to leave and the two boarding the ship; even Blom's fate is reported outright.

fracture.basis: Text states the central part is a flashback dream framed by the return, so the bulk is displaced inside a present-tense bracket.

dread.basis: Unhappiness accumulates — a fled marriage, a pregnancy, a mother's secret — but nothing is anticipated as harm until the train

cruelty.basis: Real harm (abandonment, a boyfriend who does not love her, the abortion) yet no one is condemned; the mother simply leaves for Hokkaido

irony.basis: Confrontations, the abortion, the death are played straight with no gap between what's shown and meant

ambiguity.basis: The text never answers Akiko's question about her paternity, nor whether stepping in front of the train was intended

fracture.basis: Single forward order; the death is skipped by an ellipsis but the sequence is unbroken

dread.basis: A murderer and a dying woman exist, but each segment's motion is toward a punchline; the vagrant can't even get arrested.

cruelty.basis: Harms are offscreen or comic — a wounded priest reported, a kidnapped child who torments his kidnappers.

irony.basis: Every segment turns on a reversal — useless gifts, painted leaf, unarrestable tramp — but the sentiment behind them is played straight.

ambiguity.basis: Each twist is explained in the telling, including that the leaf was painted and the painter died for it.

fracture.basis: Five unconnected stories with a narrator's prologue; no single order runs through the film, though each segment is linear.

dread.basis: Gunfire from executions heard regularly, a death sentence, and a cellmate who may be a plant he'd have to kill

cruelty.basis: Handcuffs, beatings, Orsini returned to await execution — real harm, but the attention is on the spoon and the door

irony.basis: A wholly procedural account of chiselling, rope-making and rooftops; nothing is shown that it doesn't mean

ambiguity.basis: They climb down and walk away undetected; nothing about the escape or Jost's loyalty is left open

fracture.basis: One forward line marked by durations — 'after fifteen days', 'weeks of work', 'that night'

dread.basis: Raids, a cordon, an informer and a dawn deadline for interrogation — capture is imminent through nearly every scene

cruelty.basis: Pina shot in front of her son; Luigi tortured to death with Don Pietro forced to watch; Ingrid takes back the fur coat

irony.basis: Don Pietro's answer about righteous work, the altar boys' whistled tune and the dome of St. Peter's are offered without distance

ambiguity.basis: Betrayal, deaths and execution are all shown and accounted for; nothing is withheld

fracture.basis: Continuous forward chronology across the days before liberation

dread.basis: The body sits in the chest used as a buffet table for the whole party, with the housekeeper trying to open it and Rupert circling.

cruelty.basis: They kill a classmate as an exercise, feed his father from the chest holding him, and send him home with books tied in the murder rope.

irony.basis: Rupert repudiates his own Nietzsche talk to camera-level plainness and fires for the police; the film's judgement is unhidden.

ambiguity.basis: The lid comes up, the body is found, guilt is stated, and the three take their final positions as the police arrive.

fracture.basis: One party, one evening, from the strangling to the sirens with no jump backward or forward.

dread.basis: After the missing key, exposure is expected continuously; the poisoning makes it bodily and the escape happens under watch

cruelty.basis: Mother proposes she 'die slowly'; handlers coldly assign the seduction citing her past; Sebastian left to a known death

irony.basis: The romance and the sacrifice are played without distance — Devlin's stoic front is a character's mask, not the film's

ambiguity.basis: Uranium proven, poisoners exposed, love confessed; only Sebastian's off-screen fate is left implied

fracture.basis: Continuous forward order from recruitment to the car pulling away

dread.basis: Closes with the boat lost, provisions gone, starvation, and a takeoff in a repaired wartime plane — harm expected and unresolved.

cruelty.basis: Liza makes the dog swim until it drowns from exhaustion, then takes its place on a leash; the text stays with the dominance game.

irony.basis: The 'female dog' role and a man who prefers conversing with his dog are set out as a game he accepts, with no framing that mocks it.

ambiguity.basis: Ends mid-attempt in the air with no outcome; Liza's motive for the dog and Giorgio's indifference are never accounted for.

fracture.basis: Continuous chronology: arrival, the dog, Paris, return, the lost boat.

dread.basis: Maganlal's knife-throwing show using Jatayu as bait and the warning to drop the case put threat over the trio, but framed as amusement

cruelty.basis: Innocent idol-maker Shashibabu tracked down and 'murdered brutally by stabbing'; harassment staged as a spectator sport

irony.basis: Straight detective adventure: vow, deduction, sting operation, and praise for his skills, all taken at face value

ambiguity.basis: 'Finally, everything is revealed' — every posed question answered, plus a last explanatory twist about the replica

fracture.basis: One forward line; only the closing reconstruction restates earlier events out of order

dread.basis: Refusal carries a standing seppuku order, and the demand for the daimyo's head makes armed retribution certain long before it arrives.

cruelty.basis: Ichi is held at spearpoint to renounce her marriage and impales herself; her husband is cut down holding her; Isaburo is shot by hidden guns.

irony.basis: The clan's reversal — ordered to marry her, then ordered to give her back — is absurd, but the film honours the rebellion straight.

ambiguity.basis: All parties die and the surviving infant is placed with the wet nurse; nothing is withheld.

fracture.basis: Dated opening and unbroken forward march from the marriage order to the final duel.

dread.basis: A nightmare and a drunk contemplation of jumping from the moving train — threat is one interior moment, not sustained.

cruelty.basis: He refused Lahiri a job and refused Biresh; Aditi answers with empathy bordering on pity and tears up her notes.

irony.basis: Confession all night, then he 'slips back into the role of the star' — the film shows the mask being resumed knowingly.

ambiguity.basis: He asks her how he is and she answers for him; whether the unburdening changed anything is left unstated.

fracture.basis: One train journey carrying inset episodes — Shankar-da, Lahiri, Biresh — plus a nightmare, interleaved with other passengers.

dread.basis: The herald announces the departure in advance, so the second half is spent waiting for a collapse already promised

cruelty.basis: The Visitor only gives — suicide prevented, anxieties soothed; the ruin afterward is self-inflicted and watched without blame

irony.basis: 'A typical bourgeois family' plus an arm-flapping postman herald: the household is a demonstration case, not people

ambiguity.basis: The Visitor is never identified or explained, and the film ends on a naked scream on Etna rather than an account

fracture.basis: Arrival then departure in order; only the fanning out into five parallel fates loosens the single line

dread.basis: Infection spreads floor by floor from the first murder to the pool; St. Luc is 'thwarted at every turn' and the last shot exports it to the city

cruelty.basis: Belly slit and filled with acid in the opening; hallway rapes; a little girl infected and shown swimming to hold him under

irony.basis: Hobbes's 'beautiful mindless orgy' manifesto set against assault; the infected smile seductively and the coda is a calm news report

ambiguity.basis: Linsky reads the notes aloud and the parasite's purpose is stated outright; the ending is unambiguous spread

fracture.basis: Continuous forward escalation through one building over days

dread.basis: Emma's overdose and the trampled child are shocks inside a drift; nothing is anticipated between them

cruelty.basis: Robert slaps Sylvia and orders her to bed; the crowd tears the tree apart and tramples a sick child in the melee

irony.basis: A Christ statue flown over Rome while the second helicopter chases sunbathers; the Madonna sighting staged for radio and TV

ambiguity.basis: Episodes close on nothing — Maddalena's proposal unanswered, the novel unwritten, the father's taxi driving off

fracture.basis: Numbered Day/Night/Dawn blocks with a prologue and intermezzo — consecutive, but built as detachable panels

dread.basis: Nose slashed by a henchman, Mulvihill's thugs at the retirement home, then Gittes taken to Chinatown at gunpoint

cruelty.basis: Gittes repeatedly slaps Evelyn; the incest of a 15-year-old is revealed; she is shot dead and Cross walks off with the girl

irony.basis: 'Forget it, Jake. It's Chinatown' steps back from the ending, but the scheme and its cost are presented straight

ambiguity.basis: The bifocals, the reservoir, the land grab and the paternity are all explained; Cross confesses the whole scheme

fracture.basis: Case advances lead by lead in one forward order with no displacement

dread.basis: A released rapist stalks the family from the first scene onward, unarrestable for lack of proof, until the riverbank

cruelty.basis: Dog killed, a child driven into traffic, a prior victim beaten, wife assaulted and daughter raped as bait

irony.basis: The final choice — prison over death, quoted back as 'count the years' — is meant exactly as spoken

ambiguity.basis: Cady is shot, incapacitated and sentenced by the hero's decision; the family sails off safely with police

fracture.basis: Release, stalking, flight, confrontation — one forward chain

dread.basis: A killer keeps working — wife, box-office clerk — while Julien hides and Barbara walks prostitution alleys alone

cruelty.basis: Four murders planned by an intimate (lawyer kills lover, witness, would kill client), but the text dwells on the chase, not the wounds

irony.basis: The man they assault turns out to be the priest who later marries them — the plot arranges tidy jokes over its corpses

ambiguity.basis: Clement confesses every murder and motive on the phone before dying; the case closes completely

fracture.basis: Single forward investigation, Nice research included, told in order

dread.basis: A staged assault, a second attempt during the move, a telescope trained on her window, and the same driver picking her up again

cruelty.basis: Andrea hires a man to assault Emily to harvest a recording, then replays and recites it — harm commissioned for pleasure

irony.basis: The stalking and the taxi trap are presented as straight menace; the slap and the doorway reunion are meant as they look

ambiguity.basis: Obecny is arrested and 'confessing to the entire plot'; the confrontation names the motive and the ordeal is declared over

fracture.basis: One forward chain from the first attack to the arrest and the final doorway

dread.basis: Anne alone all night unsure which customer is the escaped killer; Richard's hair growing wrong; Brent waiting for the killer to retake him

cruelty.basis: Machete chase, grotesque drawing of beheaded people, a man farmed for consumption — harm is inflicted but briskly dispatched

irony.basis: Coroner host who turns out to be a corpse himself, and a station sited 'near Haddonfield' — the film winks at its own genre

ambiguity.basis: Every tale states its mechanism: the aliens explain themselves, the eye's donor is named, the host is unmasked

fracture.basis: Three self-contained tales in a coroner's frame that reopens at the end — segmented, but no order is displaced

dread.basis: A countdown structure — delays, espionage sweeps, Tickling the Dragon's Tail — running toward a detonation the film names in advance.

cruelty.basis: The camera stays for Merriman's swelling and deformation over days while the nurse can only watch; Tatlock's death follows an order.

irony.basis: Conscience debated openly by the scientists; 'everyone watches in awe' at the mushroom cloud is offered without undercutting.

ambiguity.basis: Dated to the second (05:29:45, July 16, 1945); both designs work, and the film says so.

fracture.basis: September 1942 forward to Trinity, one order, no displacement.

dread.basis: The killing is announced up front; what follows is inquest and gossip, with menace returning only at the shotgun

cruelty.basis: De Janzé masturbates beside the corpse, Broughton shoots the dog then himself in front of Diana, the set parties on her grave

irony.basis: Feigned drunkenness, a public toast to his wife's affair, and a final tableau of revellers around a suicide's grave

ambiguity.basis: Acquitted with no witnesses and only circumstantial evidence; Diana's later 'further evidence' is never adjudicated

fracture.basis: Opens on the body found in January 1941, then returns to the affair that led there

dread.basis: The overdose opens the film; afterward the tension is relapse and career, and the pills she takes are vomited up.

cruelty.basis: Doris feeding her nine-year-old sleeping pills and stealing the spotlight; producers' remarks about her being out of shape.

irony.basis: An actress playing scenes about acting, notes from three producers, ending on her performing inside another film.

ambiguity.basis: Sobriety holds, mother reconciled at the bedside, doctor waiting, new work secured — every line closed.

fracture.basis: Strictly sequential from set to hospital to rehab to new film.

dread.basis: Killing spreads by contact through strangers, reaches the investigator's colleague and wife, and the last shot is a waitress drawing a knife.

cruelty.basis: X carved into victims' necks and chests, a mother killing her son, and Fumie found decomposed with an X cut into her throat.

irony.basis: Hypnosis, the cylinder recording and Mamiya's evasions are staged in earnest; nothing is offered for the audience to disbelieve.

ambiguity.basis: Mamiya's method and origin stay unexplained, Fumie's death and Sakuma's 'suicide' are unattributed, and the closing waitress goes unexplained.

fracture.basis: Straight investigative order; the only inserts are a viewed videotape and a played cylinder, both within scenes.

dread.basis: Invisible stalker present from arrival; skinned corpses foreshadow, then the team is picked off one at a time over the whole film.

cruelty.basis: Bodies skinned and hung in trees, skulls taken as trophies; but the killing is sport-code, and it spares the unarmed Anna.

irony.basis: War cry, mud, hand-to-hand duel and a self-destructing enemy played entirely straight; no gap between image and intent.

ambiguity.basis: Hunter's rules deduced onscreen (heat, threat), it dies, Dutch is extracted at dawn; only the alien's origin goes unstated.

fracture.basis: Single forward order from the shuttle's arrival to the dawn pickup, with no displacement.

dread.basis: A standoff and a pulled grenade pin resolve into farce and popcorn; menace only returns with the parachute drop and the bombing run.

cruelty.basis: The rescue team threatens and harasses the chief and Yeo-il dies in crossfire, but the film's business is soldiers feeding a village.

irony.basis: Butterfly storms, popcorn snow and the butterflies rising where the soldiers died are offered as literal wonder, undefended.

ambiguity.basis: The decoy works, every defender is named as killed, and the closing butterflies state the meaning outright.

fracture.basis: One forward September-onward line; the Allied command thread runs parallel and converges without any displacement.

dread.basis: Opens with San'er shooting three robbers dead unprovoked; each vignette accumulates humiliation that the form has taught you ends in blood.

cruelty.basis: Hush money after a beating, a shotgun rampage down to a man mistreating a horse, a woman shot for a handbag, assault with a fruit knife.

irony.basis: Opera inserts comment on the action — Lin Chong before the rampage, 'Do you plead guilty?' at the close — but the anger is unhedged.

ambiguity.basis: Each episode closes on its act and its real-world source is named; only the epilogue's question to Xiaoyu is left hanging.

fracture.basis: Four vignettes 'depicted chronologically' plus a prologue that is San'er's later episode pulled forward, and an epilogue crossing strands.

dread.basis: Himmler and Goebbels in the cabaret audience and Breitbart's foreseen Holocaust make the whole Berlin stretch a countdown.

cruelty.basis: Hanussen abuses Marta and is kidnapped and murdered once exposed as a Jew; Breitbart's own death is an infected wound, not an act.

irony.basis: A Jewish strongman sold to Nazis in a blonde wig as 'Siegfried', with a mystic fraud claiming credit for his strength.

ambiguity.basis: Final titles fix the date of death, but the closing delirium of red crabs and the brother flying away is left unexplained.

fracture.basis: Straight chronology shtetl to Berlin to Poland; only the terminal dreamscape leaves the timeline.

dread.basis: The son is already dead; tension is investigative, with the hanging and Ortiz raid as isolated spikes

cruelty.basis: Burned and dismembered body, the video of Mike torturing a captive, a stabbing over a minor quarrel, a wife murdered

irony.basis: The flag raised correctly at the start and flown upside down at the end — pointed, but the film stands behind it

ambiguity.basis: Penning confesses, the credit card signature is matched; only Mike's own despondency is left as inference

fracture.basis: Dated linear investigation, displaced only by phone videos and the recalled last conversation about the Iraqi child

dread.basis: A murder plot against Mrs. Munson is agreed and lots are drawn twice, but each attempt collapses into cuckoo clocks and cats

cruelty.basis: They resolve to kill a harmless old woman, and Gawain, Garth, Mountain Girl are shot and garrotted — all staged as pratfalls

irony.basis: Killers die by raven, gargoyle and their own gun barrel while the pious widow gets the loot; the film arranges cosmic punchlines

ambiguity.basis: Every gang member accounted for, money donated, final shot ties off the severed finger

fracture.basis: Heist told beginning to end with no displacement

dread.basis: Ten years of both moles fearing exposure; rooftop meetings, a man thrown off a roof, and a head shot in a lift.

cruelty.basis: Wong thrown from the roof, Chan shot mid-negotiation, Big B executed in the lift — deliberate but quickly done.

irony.basis: Mirror-structure of two moles is engineered, and Lau salutes the man he doomed; the film still plays its grief straight.

ambiguity.basis: Both identities exposed, files corrected, Chan buried with honours, Big B named as the mole — every question is closed.

fracture.basis: Straight forward chronology across ten years; one closing flashback to the academy expulsion.

dread.basis: Recurring visions of Padmé dying in childbirth hang over every scene, and Order 66 is telegraphed as a galaxy-wide slaughter.

cruelty.basis: Vader massacres the Temple Jedi, strangles his pregnant wife, is dismembered and burned alive on camera, then lied to about her death.

irony.basis: Operatic pledges, remorseful denunciations and prophecy played entirely straight; no image is undercut.

ambiguity.basis: Every thread closes into placement: twins hidden, Obi-Wan exiled on Tatooine, Death Star underway.

dread.basis: Missile launch and quake sequence create brief peril, but the arc is discovery, flight and public rescue, not sustained threat.

cruelty.basis: Luthor plans to sink the western US and weakens Superman with Kryptonite, but harm is schematic and Lois's death is undone.

irony.basis: Jonathan's 'special purpose', the crest of the House of El and the flight over the city are played entirely straight.

ambiguity.basis: Time is reversed, the coast saved, Luthor jailed; nothing is left unsettled or unexplained.

fracture.basis: Single forward order from Krypton to Metropolis; only the closing rewind of time displaces the sequence at all.

dread.basis: Pressures are bureaucratic and comic — marriage bans, a billboard, a raffle; nothing in any episode threatens bodily harm.

cruelty.basis: Il Lavoro's wife charging her husband for sex, and the employer's ban on marriage, are cold humiliations rather than violence.

irony.basis: The morality crusader is destroyed by a milk billboard hallucination; each episode inverts its own moralism.

ambiguity.basis: Dr Antonio is carted off mid-delirium to a children's jingle and Zoe's 'other plans' are left standing, unexplained.

fracture.basis: Four unconnected episodes by four directors, each internally linear; no single order links them, and one is cut from some prints.

dread.basis: Bombings escalate bus to theatre to school to federal building, and martial law follows — the threat never lifts.

cruelty.basis: Husseini is tortured and killed on screen by Devereaux; Arab men including Haddad's son are rounded up into a stadium.

irony.basis: Hubbard's speech about the liberties predecessors died for is delivered as the film's own position, undefended.

ambiguity.basis: Devereaux arrested, martial law ended, detainees freed — only Samir's 'there will never be a last cell' is left open.

fracture.basis: Straight chronological investigation; Bridger's backstory is delivered as spoken confession, not displaced telling.

dread.basis: From the shooting of Vito onward every meeting may be an ambush, and Vito explicitly predicts the traitor's approach.

cruelty.basis: Severed horse head in Woltz's bed, Luca garroted, Carlo beating Connie and then garroted himself — the film stays to watch.

irony.basis: Baptism vows intercut with simultaneous assassinations, and the closing door on Kay after Michael's lie, open a gap.

ambiguity.basis: Barzini named as mastermind, Tessio's betrayal exposed, Carlo confesses; every question the plot raises is answered.

fracture.basis: One forward decade, Sicily and New York running in parallel present tense with no displacement.

dread.basis: Hyun-seo is alive in the sewer with the creature for most of the running time while the family is hunted by quarantine.

cruelty.basis: The creature regurgitates children and kills Hee-bong; authorities plan to lobotomize Gang-du to keep the hoax quiet.

irony.basis: The virus is invented, Agent Yellow is dumped on protesters, and the closing news broadcast is simply switched off.

ambiguity.basis: Monster killed and family fate settled; only the unexplained noise at the river, investigated and found to be nothing.

fracture.basis: A dated 2000 prologue then continuous 2006 action; brief cuts between separated family members keep one clock.

dread.basis: The porter is murdered before he can speak and Martins is watched from doorways, but much of it is inquiry not threat.

cruelty.basis: Diluted penicillin left children dying of meningitis, shown to Martins in the ward; Lime sells Anna to the Soviets.

irony.basis: Lime's Ferris-wheel speech on the insignificance of his victims, and a pulp Western writer as investigator.

ambiguity.basis: The final shot is heard, not seen, after Lime's slight nod; Anna walks past Martins without a word of explanation.

fracture.basis: Linear from arrival at the funeral to the second funeral; the past is reached only through testimony.

dread.basis: Long pastoral stretches with only debt and confinement, until the sudden fatal beating in the bank at the very end.

cruelty.basis: Fifty-four unpaid sharecroppers held in ignorance, and bank customers beat Lazzaro to death for holding a slingshot.

irony.basis: The wolf, the organ music that follows them out of the church, and the saint's death are offered without hedging.

ambiguity.basis: Lazzaro wakes unaged after decades with no explanation, and the wolf is left explicitly perhaps real, perhaps symbolic.

fracture.basis: One forward order, but an unmarked leap of many years splits it, and the opening emerges gradually rather than being set.

dread.basis: Overdose, cold turkey and Begbie's unprovoked violence recur, but the drive is appetite and scheming between crises.

cruelty.basis: Dawn dies of neglect and the group keeps using; Renton steals Tommy's sex tape, and Tommy dies of AIDS.

irony.basis: The betting-shop toilet becomes a swim, parents answer HIV questions on a game show, Dawn crawls on the ceiling.

ambiguity.basis: Renton takes the money, Begbie is arrested, and a post-credit scene closes Spud's line with £4,000.

fracture.basis: Forward chronology throughout; only hallucination sequences interrupt, and they sit in their scene's present.

dread.basis: Hawk attack, duels and a drowning threat, but each is defused comically and the town's crisis is a water shortage.

cruelty.basis: Merrimack drowned, Rango and Beans sealed in the vault to drown, and Jake drags the mayor off — all offhand.

irony.basis: A pet chameleon invents 'Rango' as a role, and the Spirit of the West tells him no man can walk out on his own story.

ambiguity.basis: Mayor's valve scheme exposed, water restored, Rango stays as sheriff — every thread closed.

fracture.basis: One forward line from the vivarium falling out of the car to the celebration in Dirt.

dread.basis: The only anticipated harms are social — nausea, ostracism, Mika leaving; no threat hangs over anyone.

cruelty.basis: The father's abandonment and the neighbours' contempt are real, yet the film ends by putting the stone in his hands.

irony.basis: The stone-letter pressed to the pregnant belly and the furnace operator's anecdote are offered without any defence.

ambiguity.basis: The father is recognized, the stone explains him, and Mika stops objecting — everything withheld is finally delivered.

fracture.basis: Straight forward from the orchestra disbanding; the father's past arrives as recalled memory inside the present scene.

dread.basis: Long confident ascent — gang expands unchecked — before doom arrives late: 'hunted down one by one' after the Mafia strikes

cruelty.basis: Yamamoto badly hurts Denny at first meeting, gang 'quickly and brutally' takes territory; yet ends in Denny's grief for him

irony.basis: The punctured-cup cheat returns as sincere payoff — the money in the bag — with no gap between image and feeling

ambiguity.basis: Yamamoto's sudden loss of interest is never explained: 'just sitting silently thinking about something'; his death is unshown

fracture.basis: Single forward order from clan defeat to LA rise to collapse; no displacement

dread.basis: War looms and kills across seven years, but the bulk is salons, duels, courtship; threat is episodic, not continuous

cruelty.basis: Anatole and Hélène prey deliberately; Borodino slaughter watched with horror — but the film forgives Pierre, Natasha, even Dolokhov

irony.basis: Pierre's disillusion with Napoleon is stated straight, and Natasha spells out the closing metaphor: the house that stands wounded

ambiguity.basis: Every strand closes — deaths, the war, the marriage — and the moral is delivered in the final dialogue

fracture.basis: Strict 1805→1812 chronicle; parallel strands but never displaced in time

dread.basis: Terminal leukemia, yakuza debt, and police closing in run concurrently the whole way; Horibe's suicide talk under it all

cruelty.basis: He kills the yakuza in a shootout, but the film's gestures are gifts — paints to Horibe, money to Tanaka's widow — and it pans away at the end

irony.basis: Robbery, gifts and the final beach are played for their own weight; no distance between what is shown and meant

ambiguity.basis: Ends on a pan to the ocean and 'two gunshots heard in the distance' — the decisive act is withheld from view

fracture.basis: Forward-moving, but the botched arrest precedes the film and Horibe's strand runs 'meanwhile' alongside Nishi's

dread.basis: Opens with a father firing on his children and shooting himself, then alternates desert peril with long oasis play; harm returns at the tree

cruelty.basis: Attempted filicide, hunters wantonly shooting buffalo, the boy's hanging body, and the girl wiping ants off his chest with little emotion

irony.basis: The woman who is seen by one party and not the other, and a coda where domestic small talk sits against the billabong memory

ambiguity.basis: The father's motive is never given, the girl never learns of the suicide, and the ending is explicitly 'either imagines or remembers'

fracture.basis: Linear walk, then a years-later jump and a closing image that cannot be placed as memory or fantasy

dread.basis: Humiliation escalates step by step to the strangling, then a manhunt with his face on the news and families hounded

cruelty.basis: A chain of deliberate degradations — Masuo throws Yoshino onto a mountain road, she abuses Yuichi, he strangles her — each dwelt on

irony.basis: The title's accusation floats over three people who each play victim and abuser; the film doesn't announce who it means

ambiguity.basis: Stops with the couple still on the run, no capture, no verdict on who the villain is

fracture.basis: Forward order with one backfill — Mitsuyo re-contacting him 'several months after their initial correspondence'

dread.basis: Agents hunt from the first scene and E.T. sickens and dies, but the middle is play, beer, Halloween; threat is bounded

cruelty.basis: No one intends harm; the quarantine is a rescue attempt by Keys, and the frogs are freed

irony.basis: 'I love you' revives him, the finger glows, a rainbow follows the ship — offered without defence

ambiguity.basis: Departure, healing, and 'I'll be right here' close every thread

fracture.basis: One continuous forward sequence from arrival to launch

dread.basis: The corpse and the investigation come first, so all seven days are spent waiting for a death already announced, with Bob in the room

cruelty.basis: Repeated rape by her father, the train car, and the Lodge literally harvesting 'garmonbozia — pain and sorrow' from her as payment

irony.basis: The Red Room's arm and cryptic speech are metaphysics played straight; Laura's suffering is never held at a distance

ambiguity.basis: Desmond vanishes, Jeffries appears and vanishes, the ring's function is never stated, and Cooper is in Laura's dream before he arrives

fracture.basis: Prologue a year earlier, Philadelphia interruption, dream containing a future Cooper and Annie, then a Red Room coda after the death

dread.basis: A neutron bomb ticks over five occupied months, but the register is siege-and-rescue with a clear countdown, not sustained expectation

cruelty.basis: Bane breaks Batman's back to gloat, publicly kills Pavel and the mayor, and stages kangaroo courts that exile the elite to death

irony.basis: Blake's first name reveal, Alfred's Florence toast, the Bat-Signal repaired — every beat means exactly what it shows

ambiguity.basis: The autopilot discovery exists solely to close the one open question; Talia, Bane and the bomb are all fully explained

fracture.basis: Forward order with cross-cut strands and one signposted five-month gap

dread.basis: Consequence compounds coldly — trial, job, prison, suicide attempt — but the axe killings arrive without being anticipated

cruelty.basis: The shopkeepers and Lucien perjure Yvon's life away for a picture frame, and he repays a woman who sheltered him by axing the household

irony.basis: A forged note passed for convenience produces mass murder; the film lays the causal chain out without commenting on it

ambiguity.basis: Every event is plain but no motive is ever given for the axe murders; he confesses without explaining

fracture.basis: A single causal chain handed from Norbert to the shop to Yvon to Lucien in strict order

the human condition ii road to eternity.wikipedia: The Human Condition II: Road to Eternity

dread.basis: Marked as a leftist suspect from day one, then beatings, Obara's suicide, and the Soviet armour arriving on unfortified flat ground

cruelty.basis: Ceaseless humiliation drives Obara to kill himself, veterans beat men for slight offenses, and Kaji lets Yoshida sink in quicksand

irony.basis: Kaji's refusals and his closing cry, 'I'm a monster, but I'm going to stay alive!', are given without any undercutting

ambiguity.basis: Events are all plain; what stays open is only his verdict on himself, shouted while searching for survivors

fracture.basis: Conscription to rout in one unbroken forward march

dread.basis: Only threats are a building demolition and the sibling revelation; both dissolve into meetings and explanations

cruelty.basis: No one harms anyone on purpose; the deaths are wartime backstory and the adults act to spare a child orphanhood

irony.basis: Flag-raising ritual and student renovation are presented straight, with the closing flags meant sincerely

ambiguity.basis: Onodera arrives expressly to confirm the parentage and tell 'the full story'; text ends 'with everything resolved'

fracture.basis: Single 1963 forward line; the 1945 history arrives entirely as spoken exposition, not displaced scenes

dread.basis: The only pressure is neighbours noticing and a missed departure; no harm is anticipated at any point

cruelty.basis: The betrayal happens offscreen by absent spouses; the two principals' whole project is refusing to inflict it

irony.basis: The rehearsal-of-the-affair scenes double the action, but the whispered-secret story is offered without defence

ambiguity.basis: The secret is sealed in a wall unspoken; the silent phone call, the woman-and-son, and Su's later life stay unknown

fracture.basis: Forward order with large stated jumps — 'the following year', 'three years later' — nothing reordered

dread.basis: Quilty shadows them in disguise for years — hotel stranger, 'Dr. Zempf', the following car, the motel phone call

cruelty.basis: A man engineers access to a child, conceals her mother's death to keep her, and Quilty demands she act in pornography

irony.basis: Humbert laughs while reading Charlotte's love letter; Quilty's impersonations and execution-invitation play as farce

ambiguity.basis: Dolores names Quilty and explains everything; a postscript even reports Humbert's cause of death

fracture.basis: Straight chronology from arrival in Ramsdale; only the closing postscript sits outside the sequence

dread.basis: Arrest, camp, Gestapo, wanted poster, the run-to-the-wall execution game; closing text says all four died within a year

cruelty.basis: They strangle Dounat because guns would be heard, Félix is tortured to near-death, and Mathilde is shot in the street

irony.basis: The killings and the de Gaulle decoration are given without any gap between image and intent

ambiguity.basis: Mathilde's release is never explained and Gerbier's end is only 'he decided not to run this time'

fracture.basis: One unbroken forward chain from arrest to the Paris shooting, closed by dated text

dread.basis: The falling stone and stalking Jackie set menace, but the mode is puzzle — bodies are found, not awaited

cruelty.basis: A wife shot in the head by her husband, plus two witnesses silenced; the film treats each as a clue to be catalogued

irony.basis: The parade of motives is served as sport, but the murders themselves are played without wink

ambiguity.basis: Poirot's saloon reconstruction accounts for the stole, handkerchief, ashtray and every death

fracture.basis: Linear cruise; the only displacement is the retrospective replay of the murder inside the solution

dread.basis: Bruno turns up at Guy's home, the party, the senator's house, and holds the lighter he means to plant

cruelty.basis: Miriam is strangled at the funfair and a party guest nearly is too; the deaths are deliberate and demonstrated

irony.basis: The party strangling-demonstration and the closing repeat of the train encounter are knowing structural jokes

ambiguity.basis: The dead hand opens on the lighter, the carnival worker names Bruno, and the police clear Guy outright

fracture.basis: Forward telling with one inserted flashback at the party as Bruno's hands close

dread.basis: A school that cannot be left, a student quietly executed after a boxing match, and a plan to kill Elwood

cruelty.basis: Administrators savagely beat both victim and bully, torture Elwood in the sweatbox, and the graves are dug up decades later

irony.basis: The diary, the exposé and the testimony are all meant exactly as shown; no distance from its own images

ambiguity.basis: The 1988 scenes withhold that the man is Turner under Elwood's name until the closing montage explains it

fracture.basis: 1962 is cut against 1988 and 2018 flashforwards whose speaker is misidentified until the end recodes them

dread.basis: Death travels with the party from the first chess move, fells Skat mid-flight, and the plague closes the country

cruelty.basis: A girl is burned at the stake while questioned about Satan, a servant is nearly raped, Raval is left to die alone

irony.basis: The flagellants and the fresco painter get satire, but the confessional plea and the strawberries are held straight

ambiguity.basis: God never answers, the witch's Satan is only her terror, and Jof's visions are left unadjudicated

fracture.basis: One forward journey from the beach to the castle and the hillside dance; nothing displaced

dread.basis: Investigators are attacked and a witness is shot in custody, but the pressure is procedural rather than continuous

cruelty.basis: A cadet gang rape restaged on the same stakes, a father who walks away leaving her tied, then strangling in a rage

irony.basis: The 'psychological warfare' campaign and the final court-martial are presented as straight moral accounting

ambiguity.basis: Kent confesses both murders before stepping on the mine; the cover-up is named and prosecuted

fracture.basis: Present-tense investigation; the West Point attack arrives as testimony inside interviews, not as displaced scenes

dread.basis: The only alarm is Nelly briefly fleeing the house; the operation is reassured about before it happens

cruelty.basis: Grief and a mother's silent departure, with everyone acting to comfort — nobody inflicts harm on anyone

irony.basis: The cabin, the birthday, the goodbye to the grandmother are played entirely for what they are

ambiguity.basis: The passage to the late 1990s is never explained or questioned, and the ending is only 'tacit recognition'

fracture.basis: Repeated returns to a 1990s past interleave with the present, though Nelly's own experience runs forward throughout

dread.basis: Worst event is boys skipping dinner and being found by the station; the missing dues turn out to be a grandmother's forgetfulness.

cruelty.basis: Gossip and neighbours pointedly returning loaned items; the wronged woman comes to apologise and is received.

irony.basis: Minoru's attack on empty niceties is then enacted straight: the tutor and aunt end discussing only the weather instead of love.

ambiguity.basis: Dues mystery explained, TV bought, silence ended; only the tutor and aunt's unspoken feelings stay unsettled.

fracture.basis: Single forward run of neighbourhood days, no displacement.

dread.basis: Alan's cover can break at any moment (Pang burns a file, Mad Dog is sent to watch him), and the hospital is held hostage over an armoury.

cruelty.basis: Alan machine-guns Hoi's surrendering men to impress Wong; Wong shoots fleeing patients and guns down the crippled ones crossing the standoff.

irony.basis: Guilt over the teahouse friendly-fire is played straight and consoled straight; the film backs its cop-heroism entirely.

ambiguity.basis: Wong shot dead, Alan revealed alive, file destroyed, new life abroad — every thread closed.

fracture.basis: Two parallel strands told forward and converging; only 'meanwhile' cuts, no displacement.

dread.basis: The only stakes are missed meetings and a fair to set up; nothing threatens anyone across the weekend.

cruelty.basis: Sharpest act is Guillaume lying that the painter left for Paris; even rebuffed suitors keep giving the twins their ride.

irony.basis: Coincidences of Simon/Yvonne and Andy/Solange are played for delight, not for mockery of the characters wanting them.

ambiguity.basis: Delphine and Maxence are finally in the same truck but their meeting is explicitly not shown onscreen.

fracture.basis: Friday to Monday in order, one town, one direction.

dread.basis: An advancing Saxon army pursues the convoy from the rescue onward, through the ice crossing to Badon Hill.

cruelty.basis: Marius's cell complex holds dead Woads and two tortured survivors; Pelagius executed for heresy; Cerdic established as ruthless.

irony.basis: Lancelot's closing narration about fallen knights living on in tales is delivered without any undercutting.

ambiguity.basis: Saxons defeated, Cerdic and Cynric killed, marriage and coronation, a promise about future invaders.

fracture.basis: One campaign told forward from discharge orders to crowning.

dread.basis: Harm arrives unheralded — Sam's stroke reported after a weekend away, Billy hit by a truck the morning after a reconciliation.

cruelty.basis: Jacy scolds Duane over the failed erection, Abilene is brutally cold dropping her off, Duane puts a bottle in Sonny's eye, townsmen blame dead Billy.

irony.basis: The last show being Red River and Ruth's 'Never you mind, honey' are offered without any distance from their feeling.

ambiguity.basis: All events settled — annulment, enlistment, Dallas — with only whether Sonny and Ruth hold left open at the coffee.

fracture.basis: Straight run from the Christmas dance through the last night of the theatre.

dread.basis: The estate brands escapees, so every scene from the sale onward is lived under the threat of capture and torture.

cruelty.basis: Mother sold into prostitution, slaves branded, Namiji carried out to die in the wilderness, Zushiō himself made an overseer.

irony.basis: The father's mercy proverb is stated, tested and finally affirmed by the mother on the beach with no gap at all.

ambiguity.basis: Slavery abolished, Sanshō exiled, Anju's death learned, mother found and identity proved by the Kannon statuette.

fracture.basis: Dated forward march 1077→1083→adulthood; the only displacement is a recalled childhood branch-breaking.

dread.basis: After the chloroform killing the threat never lifts: robbers plan to kill Nicky and Margaret, a poisoned sandwich waits, a riot builds outside.

cruelty.basis: Paraplegic wife given a fatal overdose, Cooper poisoned with lye then finished with a poker, an aunt tries to feed the boy poison.

irony.basis: A murderous insurance-fraud household is set against a 'peaceful, all-white' town rioting over the Mayers; Nicky ends playing ball as neighbours tidy up.

ambiguity.basis: Every conspirator dead by named means and Gardner's poisoning explained; nothing withheld about what happened.

fracture.basis: One spring's events in order, the two plots running side by side forward.

dread.basis: Fiver's apocalyptic vision sets the terms and threat is continuous after: hawk, snare, cat and dog, Efrafan trackers, Woundwort's ultimatum.

cruelty.basis: A farmer feeds Cowslip's warren to snare them, Efrafa is a totalitarian state, Blackavar is killed easily in the attack.

irony.basis: The Frith creation myth is stated at the start and returned to over Hazel's death, endorsed rather than undercut.

ambiguity.basis: Warren saved and Hazel's death completed, but Woundwort's body is never found and his fate is explicitly left a mystery.

fracture.basis: Mythic prologue precedes the story and a 'several years later' coda closes it; the middle is unbroken forward order.

dread.basis: Four men stranded six miles behind enemy lines for the whole film, building a raft under a general's house and a passing plane.

cruelty.basis: A peasant girl is belted to a tree, guarded, then shot dead when she runs; enemy soldiers killed at their meal for food and rifles.

irony.basis: Opening narration declares the war, the forest and the enemies not to exist — 'no other country but the mind' — before any of it is shown.

ambiguity.basis: Countries unnamed and outside history by declaration; ends on Mac dying and Sidney delirious in the drifting raft, unresolved.

fracture.basis: Narrated frame then a straight two-day march from crash to river; the split into raft and infiltration is concurrent, not displaced.

dread.basis: Deaths arrive as news within a social round — Elisa's, Ramona's, Andrea's — and threaten nothing ongoing.

cruelty.basis: Jep socially humiliates Stefania by exposing her secrets; a widower learns from a diary he was a 35-year surrogate.

irony.basis: Rome's historical beauty is set in 'merciless contrast' with its inhabitants' superficiality, and the hero is 'king' of the world he indicts.

ambiguity.basis: Episodic drift with no plot to close; ends on a Céline epigraph's terms with only 'a glimmer of hope' about writing again.

fracture.basis: Loose succession of parties and encounters rather than a causal line, closing on a flashback to first meeting Elisa.

dread.basis: He quotes his Tibetan book before each murder; the wife's hanging and the son's rod-killing arrive as long-telegraphed inevitabilities
